explication: This repository is a curated, categorized collection of step-by-step guides for recreating technologies. The principal workflow is a learner browsing the README’s category index, selecting a topic, and following an external guide. The tree exposes no runtime code, so this map represents the documented catalog rather than an application architecture; the README names categories, but the excerpt does not show every category’s guide list.
